**What would you like to see?**
Describe the feature or the change. Deutsch ist genauso willkommen wie Englisch.

**What problem does it solve?**
The situation in the game or in the overlay where you miss it today.

**Core or add-on?**
Which part it belongs to. If it is a new add-on idea, say so; the [SDK manual](../../docs/SDK_MANUAL.md) shows how add-ons are built, in case you want to try it yourself.

**Anything else?**
Screenshots, mock-ups, links to similar tools.
